settings.title: SETTINGS
settings.help: LEFT/RIGHT adjusts values. Changes are saved automatically.

how.title: HOW TO PLAY
p1_lines: Pass: F (when a teammate / Duke Blood Echo exists)
p2_lines: Pass: RIGHT SHIFT (when a teammate / Duke Blood Echo exists)
rule_lines: First player to reach the target score wins
Hold shoot, then release in the green zone
general_lines: Dunk: carry the ball above the rim, then descend
Blocks and rebounds trigger while jumping
Use each character ability to create an advantage
Duke: use the character ability to summon Blood Echo
Duke: the body and Blood Echo use different forms; control switches to the receiver after a pass
